_meta.purpose: K10 deliverable — the USSD navigation map the engine drives. Design is LABEL-DRIVEN: at each menu the engine reads the on-screen text and picks the option whose label matches, using the numeric option only as a fallback. This survives promo items and re-ordered menus far better than blind step-index injection.

_verification.status: VERIFIED on a live SIM for check_balance and send_money, both fully confirmed end-to-end including the confirm_number step and the post-result dialog dismiss. buy_data was removed from the app for now (only send_money and check_balance are supported).
devices_tested: TODO: fill in phone model(s) — only recorded as verified on whatever phone this SIM check ran on; K10's own protocol calls for two devices before calling it fully done
_verification.how_to_verify: Dial *170# on a real MTN SIM, walk each flow, and correct every label + fallback_option to match EXACTLY what appears on screen. Use 1 pesewa test transfers to a teammate, or cancel before the final PIN. Then set status to VERIFIED with your name, date and the two devices tested. See docs/07_K10_USSD_MAPPING_GUIDE.md.
warnings: MoMo WALLET balance requires the PIN (it is inside a menu), so 'check_balance' also ends in a PIN hand-off. The only PIN-free single-shot is airtime balance (*124#), which is a different, non-MoMo thing.

CONFIRMED ON THIS SIM: the send_money review screen and the PIN prompt are the SAME screen ('Transfer to X for GHS.. Fee is GHS 0.00, Tax amount is GHS 1.00. Enter MM PIN or 2 to cancel'). There is no separate 'Confirm/Cancel' menu — detect.pin_markers catches this screen directly, and UssdNavigator now speaks it (amount+fee+tax) before handing off to the PIN, so the K05 'read the total before the PIN' rule still holds without an explicit review step.

The main menu is PAGED — 'My Wallet' is not on the first screen. Page 1 (Transfer Money / MomoPay&Pay Bill / Airtime&Bundles / Allow Cash Out / Financial) must be advanced with '#' before 'My Wallet' (and Just4U, Momo App) appear as options 6-8. check_balance's first step now sends '#' as a literal input for exactly this reason.
CONFIRMED ON THIS SIM: send_money's 'Confirm Number' step re-asks for the same number you typed at 'Enter mobile number' — confirm_number now injects {recipient_number} again, same as recipient.

CONFIRMED ON THIS SIM: after any result, a native 'Cancel/Send'-style dialog is left on screen. UssdAccessibilityService.dismissResultDialog() now taps Cancel automatically whenever the navigator reaches a terminal state (success, failure, or timeout) — see UssdNavigator.finish().

NOT YET VERIFIED ON A SIM: the Telecel/AT route (Transfer menu 5) Other Networks -> 'Transfer Money to other Network' -> 1) AT / 2) Telecel) comes from Frederick's walkthrough. The prompts after it (mobile number / confirm number / amount / reference / PIN screen) are assumed identical to the MTN route. If a later step stalls on an other-network number, that step's 'expect' phrase probably doesn't match the real wording.
Menu labels and numbers differ by account type and change with promotions. Do not hardcode; match by label.

MTN: "Confirm Number" — re-enter the same number you typed at the recipient step. AT/Telecel word this screen differently (the exact phrase 'confirm number' did not match on an AT number), so any screen saying 'confirm' / 're-enter' is accepted.
"Enter Reference" — the user's own reference (symbol board field, default "1"); the engine always fills {reference}, so this step never sends blank. The verified capture showed "Reference: 1".

send_money._note: No separate review/pin_prompt step here on purpose — see the _verification.warnings entry above. The combined review+PIN screen is caught by detect.pin_markers before step-matching runs at all.
